name: Nekogami-sama no Sumu Yashiro
source:
The protagonist was staying at a certain village for some rest,
but suddenly he is assigned as a sacrifice for the "Cat Gods".

There are three Cat Gods in the shrine: Miyabi, Shinogu and Tamaki.

What is the sacrifice supposed to do,
to comfort these gods who are all in their reproductive season...?

What will he face at the ceremony...?

[From  [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE204083.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
主角在某村落休息，
但突然他被指定为“猫神”的祭品。

神社里供奉着三位猫神：雅、筱宫和玉木。

牺牲应该做什么，
来安慰这些正值生育季节的神灵……？

典礼上他将面临什么……？

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE204083.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
